assumptions: a routine summarised BALANCED returns to its call site with the stack as it found it
abstract cells track provenance, not values: a frame overwritten by a store into $0100-$01FF is not detected
RTI frames are not modelled per routine
method: per-routine abstract stack interpretation over the CFG, with a fixpoint over callee summaries
